item.title: Australian Phenom Dane Henry Got a Bells CT Wildcard, Delivered by Mick Fanning
item.description: Dane Henry, one of Australia's most talented young surfers, will get a chance to compete among the world's best when the CT season kicks off.

item.title: Mason Ho Rides a 5’6″ at Firing Pipeline and Backdoor
item.description: Most people don't opt for a 5'6" when Pipeline looks like this, but Mason Ho isn't most people. He's Mason Ho, and he can tear apart big Pipeline on anything.

item.title: Ex-Girlfriend of Norwegian Biathlete Who Confessed to Cheating on Live Broadcast Responds
item.description: The ex-girlfriend of the Norwegian biathlete who confessed to cheating on his partner in an Olympic interview, responded to his now-viral bid to get her back.

item.title: American Backcountry Skiers Rescued Near Olympic Venue
item.description: This week, two skiers became lost in the mountains of Livigno, near one of the venues for the Winter Olympic Games, necessitating a nighttime rescue.

item.title: Three Skiers Killed in Avalanche After Red-Alert Warning Shut Down Resorts
item.description: Three skiers have been killed by an avalanche at a French ski resort Friday, part of a mounting death toll this European ski season.

item.title: NOAA: La Niña Weather Pattern Likely Wrapping Up This Spring
item.description: NOAA gives a 56 percent chance that ENSO-neutral conditions will persist through the Northern Hemisphere's June-August summer months.
